boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Pomona College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops in Claremont with directly published evening hours.

cards.title: Denny’s, 820 S Indian Hill Blvd
cards.subtitle: Claremont — open 24 hours
cards.notes: Use this round-the-clock diner for a late meal; check the location page again if a holiday visit is planned.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its 820 S Indian Hill Blvd restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill, 885 S Indian Hill Blvd
cards.subtitle: Claremont — daily until 10 PM
cards.notes: Order pickup or dine in before the posted 10 PM close; this location is near Interstate 10 and Indian Hill Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists this Claremont restaurant's hours as 10:45 AM–10 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily restaurant hours through 10 PM and in-store pickup.

cards.title: Corky’s Kitchen & Bakery
cards.subtitle: 2213 E Base Line Rd, Suite 200 — daily until 10 PM
cards.notes: Plan a seated meal or bakery stop before the daily 10 PM close at this Base Line Road location.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant-and-bakery option open nightly until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Corky’s lists its Claremont location at 2213 E Base Line Rd and daily hours of 6:30 AM–10 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant page lists daily service until 10 PM.

cards.title: Elvira’s Finest Foods of Mexico
cards.subtitle: 415 W Foothill Blvd — Fri–Sat until 10 PM
cards.notes: Aim for Friday or Saturday evening for the latest posted close; Sunday through Thursday service ends at 9 PM.
cards.short_summary: Mexican restaurant with later Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Elvira’s lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 AM–10 PM at 415 W Foothill Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours until 10 PM; other listed days close at 9 PM.

cards.title: Pizza N’ Such
cards.subtitle: 202 Yale Ave — Wed–Sat until 9 PM
cards.notes: Use pickup or dine in during the Wednesday–Saturday 9 PM window; Sunday and Monday close earlier at 8:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: Family-owned pizzeria with 9 PM midweek-to-weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza N’ Such lists Wednesday–Saturday hours of 11 AM–9 PM at 202 Yale Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Wednesday–Saturday service until 9 PM and carry-out availability.

cards.title: Claremont Village Eatery
cards.subtitle: 232 W Bonita Ave — Saturdays until 9 PM
cards.notes: Make this a Saturday stop for the latest posted close; weekday service ends at 6 PM and Sunday service at 4 PM.
cards.short_summary: A Bonita Avenue eatery with a Saturday 9 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Claremont Village Eatery lists Saturday hours of 6 AM–9 PM at 232 W Bonita Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Saturday hours until 9 PM; it is closed Tuesdays.

cards.title: Eddie’s Italian Eatery
cards.subtitle: 1065 W Foothill Blvd — Fri–Sat until 9 PM
cards.notes: Plan for Friday or Saturday to use the latest posted dinner hours; Tuesday through Thursday and Sunday close at 8:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: Italian-American restaurant serving until 9 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Eddie’s lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 AM–9 PM at 1065 W Foothill Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Official contact page lists Friday–Saturday service until 9 PM.

cards.title: Tutti Mangia Italian Chophouse
cards.subtitle: 102 Harvard Ave — Fri–Sat until 10 PM
cards.notes: Reserve or walk in for a Friday or Saturday dinner before the 10 PM close; posted hours are shorter on other days.
cards.short_summary: A Harvard Avenue dinner option with 10 PM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tutti Mangia lists Friday hours of 5–10 PM and Saturday hours of 4–10 PM at 102 Harvard Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official booking page lists Friday and Saturday service through 10 PM.

cards.title: Menkoi Ya Ramen
cards.subtitle: 333 W Bonita Ave — listed until 9:30 PM
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s live hours before leaving, then head to Bonita Avenue for a late ramen dinner.
cards.short_summary: A Bonita Avenue ramen restaurant listing a 9:30 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Menkoi Ya Ramen lists its address as 333 W Bonita Ave and posted hours until 9:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant page displays hours through 9:30 PM; confirm live hours before travel.

cards.title: House of Pong
cards.subtitle: 238 N Yale Ave — Fri until midnight; Sat until 11 PM
cards.notes: For the latest posted service, go Friday before midnight; Saturday closes at 11 PM and other listed nights earlier.
cards.short_summary: An Asian-fusion restaurant with a posted Friday midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: House of Pong lists Friday hours of 11:30 AM–12 AM and Saturday hours of 11:30 AM–11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant site lists Friday service until 12 AM and Saturday service until 11 PM.
